source_evidence: Conducting a thorough inquiry into a broker’s services, fee arrangements, and investment offerings will help you select a broker capable of serving your investment objectives.
answer: When selecting a broker, start by identifying the services and products you need, then compare what each broker offers and any limitations. Ask how the broker is paid, what fees you may owe, and whether conflicts of interest could affect recommendations. You can also check the broker’s legal or disciplinary history, and check both the individual and the firm. Before agreeing to services, read and understand the account agreement and the applicable relationship summary and disclosures. These steps can help you assess whether a broker’s offerings fit your investment objectives.
